proof_summary: Take the counterexample \(n=33085221781504=2^{14}\cdot4409\cdot458009\), where the two odd factors are prime. Writing \(T(n)=\sum_{d\mid n}\sigma_1(d)\), the identity \(a(n)=2\sigma_1(n)-T(n)\) and multiplicativity give \(\sigma_1(n)=32767\cdot4410\cdot458010=66183576284700\) and \(T(n)=65519\cdot4411\cdot458011=132367152569399\), so \(a(n)=1\) although \(n\ne1,12\).
